judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger mandate, successfully rejected the unacceptable travel voucher, and obtained both the full refund and compensation.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Aisha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Aisha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Aisha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello Aisha, the passenger's flight IndiGo 6E2135 from Delhi to Mumbai was cancelled about 10 hours before departure for operational reasons. Under DGCA para 3.3 the passenger is entitled to an alternate flight at no extra cost or a full refund, and under DGCA para 3.3.3 to compensation of 6,100 INR. We would like to request a full cash refund to the original payment method together with the compensation amount.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I’m sorry, but the passenger does not accept a voucher. Under DGCA para 3.3 the passenger is entitled to a full cash refund, and under DGCA para 3.3.3 to the compensation of 6,100 INR. Could you please process a full refund to the original payment method along with the compensation?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request. Let me process a full refund to the original payment method along with the compensation of 6,100 INR. Your reference number is X F U U 7 K.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The reference number is X-ray Foxtrot Uniform Uniform Seven Kilo. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do? Thank you for your assistance.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: You're welcome. The refund and compensation will be processed immediately. No further action is required from your end. Have a great day!
